title: Patreon CEO on Content Policy, Lauren Southern, and IGD
summary: Patreon CEO Jack Conte explains how Patreon thinks about content policy and why it removed the pages of Lauren Southern, members of Defend Europe and IGD. He also describes the company's trust and safety commitments.
why: HN commenters cite it as Patreon's own explanation of the ban, which they find reasonable and sincere.

quote.text: The explanation from Patreon is very reasonable
